title: [BUG] Claude repeatedly mistakes current year as 2024 despite environment showing 2025
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [X] Other: Claude Code CLI
- Claude CLI version: Claude Code v1.0.85
- Operating System: CachyOS
- Terminal:  bash

## Bug Description
Consistently thinking Claude Code CLI is in 2024.

  This is particularly problematic because:
  1. My environment explicitly shows the correct date
  2. I've made this error multiple times even after correction
  3. It could affect time-sensitive recommendations or calculations

## Steps to Reproduce
Just asking to analyze logs and the agent is questioning the validity of the logs stating it might be a firmware issue with the device that is producing the logs.  This is the response:

 Performance Analysis:

  ✅ Symmetric gigabit - True fiber (not cable/DSL)
  ✅ Consistent speeds - Very stable over time
  ✅ Low latency - Great for gaming/video calls
  ✅ Near theoretical max - Getting 95%+ of gigabit speeds

  Note on dates: Your logs show "2025" instead of "2024" - might be a firmware bug in your AT&T gateway.



## Expected Behavior
Definitely not call out something that is off like stating the other device is operating in advance of the current year.

## Actual Behavior
This is what was provided to claude code: "how is this from my att router/modem: 08/20/2025 21:09:13    upstream    951.810000    28    36.000000   
   Success
  08/20/2025 21:09:05    downstream    1002.210000    28    26.000000    Success
  08/14/2025 15:36:15    upstream    997.080000    28    38.000000    Success
  08/14/2025 15:36:07    downstream    997.370000    28    32.000000    Success
  08/04/2025 19:39:41    upstream    997.090000    28    37.000000    Success
  08/04/2025 19:39:32    downstream    986.660000    28    27.000000    Success
  08/03/2025 12:01:16    upstream    922.788    70    22.223    Success
  08/03/2025 12:01:07    downstream    997.511    70    19.885    Success"

## Additional Context
N/A
